pages.text: Step through the portal ready for a fight. The Twilight Forest is the main T2 adventure dimension, and its seven bosses hold the first Simply Swords uniques.$(br2)$(bold)Portal:$() a pool of water ringed by grass with flowers on it. Throw in a $(bold)Codex Token I$() (or a diamond) to light it.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Twilight Forest is the most content-dense T2 dimension: seven bosses with unique weapons, a full progression path through the forest, and some of the best T2 loot tables.$(br2)$(bold)Boss order:$() The forest has its own progression, and you cannot reach the late zones without beating the earlier bosses. Follow the magic map for the intended order.

$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$() Twilight structure chests no longer hold diamonds; tokens and T2 materials take their place. Otherwise the forest's original loot is kept.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight materials:$() Steeleaf, Ironwood, Fiery and Knightmetal are all valid T2 gear materials.

$(bold)No guide book.$() Twilight Forest mostly guides itself: each biome leads to the next boss. Craft the $(bold)Magic Map$() (recipe in JEI) to see the dimension's layout and where the bosses are.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Naga's courtyard$(), the forest's intended first fight ($(l:icraft:bosses/t2_bosses)Tier 2 Bosses$(/l)).
